migration: v3 adds view_defaults, the person's preferred rendering for each chat kind. Existing records keep the smart defaults.
description: How chat looks for this person on every site with OpenVibe chat: timestamps, compact messages, text size, badges and emotes, AI reading permission, and preferred conversation views.

agents_read_messages.description: Whether an AI agent may read this person's chat messages. True by default: joining a Co-pilot room and writing in it is the choice, and it can be taken back. When false the digest leaves this person out entirely.
